tools.description: Run deterministic geometry, material, native-XML readback and full-certificate readiness gates without opening WinWatt.

input_contract.profile: recorded WinWatt version-profile JSON used for provenance
input_contract.readback_xml: optional native XML exported after WinWatt reopen

output_contract.readback_validation: readback_validation.json when readback XML is supplied
output_contract.layer_audit: layer_audit.json when a catalogue is supplied

preconditions: input files are local and immutable during validation
model geometry has been reviewed or is explicitly marked for review
readback XML belongs to the same source model when supplied
postconditions: report.status is passed, review_required or failed
every release gate has a status and issue list
g5_calculation reports whether reviewed G1-G4 inputs are ready for calculation
tools.retry_policy: rerun only into a fresh output directory after an input changes
tools.idempotency: deterministic for identical local input bytes and tolerance apart from timestamps and output paths

evidence.assertion: the gate detected the known boundary-count, azimuth and room-condition readback discrepancies without starting WinWatt
the G5 calculation scope accepts reviewed systems without requiring calculation results and lists missing human review

tools.description: Summarize a live or stopped mapping campaign, verify its source hash, and compact graph progress and repeated actions without opening WinWatt.

input_contract.profile: recorded WinWatt version-profile JSON used for provenance

preconditions: the recorded source WWP still exists
postconditions: source hash is compared with the campaign baseline
job states and graph progress are compacted
canonical revisits, alternative routes, failure clusters and remaining frontier are reported
successful and failed actions remain observations only
report.llm_used reflects the campaign and no LLM is called
tools.retry_policy: may be rerun into a fresh output directory while the campaign is active
tools.idempotency: a snapshot is deterministic for unchanged campaign files apart from timestamps and output paths

evidence.assertion: the live campaign snapshot verified the unchanged source and compacted current jobs, graph progress and action outcomes without using WinWatt UI
graph analysis identifies multi-route targets, canonical revisits, unresolved revisits, failure clusters and frontier actions

tools.description: Process a local certificate PDF or XML into hashed review artifacts without network, WinWatt, or AI; safely reuse a completed identical local intake.

input_contract.profile: recorded WinWatt version-profile JSON used for provenance
input_contract.output: new or identically completed local intake directory
input_contract.input_file: local PDF or XML certificate source
input_contract.catalog_xml: required local WinWatt material catalogue for PDF input

output_contract.review_artifacts: hashed JSON files listed by the manifest

preconditions: input is a local PDF or XML file
PDF processing has a local material catalogue
an existing output manifest must match the exact source hash
postconditions: every review artifact has SHA-256 and byte size
tools.retry_policy: reuse a complete manifest only for identical source bytes; reject changed input or incomplete cache
tools.idempotency: identical local source bytes return the existing complete manifest without rebuilding artifacts

evidence.assertion: local XML intake produced hashed review artifacts with review_required true and both winwatt_started and llm_used false
